title: HKS 3x3x23 matrix-multiplication scheme database (archival snapshot of schemes.tgz, 2020-08-07)
description: Verbatim archival mirror of the scheme database by Marijn J. H. Heule, Manuel Kauers, and Martina Seidl (17,376 mutually inequivalent {-1,0,1} rank-23 schemes for 3x3 matrix multiplication). Redistributed for reproducibility and permanence only; all credit belongs to the original authors, who should be cited for the schemes. File schemes.tgz, 43,134,227 bytes, sha256 4bc8132644504a917e3c076f64df8e6619fb67c55670179853ae5fdb1583074f, originally at http://www.algebra.uni-linz.ac.at/research/matrix-multiplication/schemes.tgz (Last-Modified 2020-08-07). This snapshot is the corpus that two research notes (in github.com/gsidebottom/logic) classify new schemes against, with novelty claims pinned to the sha256.
